title: Noun + 中
shortExplanation: Express 'in the middle of', 'during', or 'in the process of'.
longExplanation: The 中 (ちゅう) grammar point is used to express that something is in the middle of, during, or in the process of happening. It is attached to a noun to convey this meaning (e.g., 勉強中, 仕事中, 会議中). It is also sometimes read as じゅう depending on the word (e.g., 授業中).

examples.en: He is in the middle of work.

examples.jp: 試験中、携帯電話を使ってはいけません。
examples.romaji: Shiken chuu, keitai denwa wo tsukatte wa ikemasen.
examples.en: During the exam, you must not use your mobile phone.

examples.jp: 映画を観ている最中に、彼は泣き始めました。
examples.romaji: Eiga o mite iru saichuu ni, kare wa naki hajimemashita.
examples.en: In the middle of watching the movie, he started to cry.

usageNote: Attaches directly to a noun (e.g. 食事中 "during a meal") - "in the middle of/during".
